Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
I'm looking to host a tournament called Pax Vampyrica. It will come with special rules. What do you think about this.

60card limit.
no combat cards in the deck. (not even combo cards that can be used in combat like swallowed by the night).
But you can use weapons, and other cards that give you effects that can be used in combat (like preturnatural strength, rötschreck, warning sirens, murder of crows, bum's rush and police department).

My vision is that this will produce more combat and deals. Think what a Renegade Garou or War Ghoul will do to a table like this?

What do you think?
